title: Ladybug holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- legs -->
  <line x1='32' y1='68' x2='22' y2='80' stroke='#5a1a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='68' y1='68' x2='78' y2='80' stroke='#5a1a1a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body shell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#e8322b'/>
  <!-- shell split line -->
  <line x1='50' y1='34' x2='50' y2='82' stroke='#8c1410' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- shell shine -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#ff7a6e'/>
  <!-- spots -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='70' r='4' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='70' r='4' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='3.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='14' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='42' y1='20' x2='34' y2='10' stroke='#2a1a3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='20' x2='66' y2='10' stroke='#2a1a3a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='10' r='2.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='29' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='29' r='3.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='30' r='1.6' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <line x1='70' y1='54' x2='80' y2='44' stroke='#2a1a3a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='54' x2='20' y2='44' stroke='#2a1a3a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 46 C44 36 32 38 32 46 C32 54 50 64 50 64 C50 64 68 54 68 46 C68 38 56 36 50 46 Z' fill='#ff5fa2' stroke='#ffb3d0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- heart shine -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ffd6e8'/>
</svg>
